This small plot near my house has my coffee trees with some enset and a few banana plants mixed in. I do not have money for chemical fertilizer on the fruit plot, so I will put the manure from my cattle and the household compost around the trees like my father taught me. The trees are the ones I planted years ago from my own seedlings, so no improved seed this season, and I will not spray chemicals. My wife and children help me with weeding, mulching and picking, and during the coffee harvest I will call two or three neighbors for a few days to help.
